messages:
Noah B: MIRAI DATA (acct: MIRAI-501) invoice INV-9134 ($125,400) flagged as 90 days past due. AP says they're disputing charges due to a major incident in April.
Tara L: They submitted a ticket claiming 40% of April usage was caused by platform incident and want a credit. CS verified incident and agreed to investigate.
Noah B: Their autopay was disabled and card attempts failed. We need a plan: do we offer a credit now or wait for usage audit?
Sam R (Legal): We shouldn't issue a credit without documented findings. Legal OKs a provisional credit note contingent on audit results and signed acknowledgement.
BillingBot: Reminder: autopay attempts: 3 failed for INV-9134. Last attempt: 1742950000. Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-9134
Tara L: CS proposes: expedite audit (7 business days), if confirmed apply credit up to 40% on April line, and ask customer to pay 50% of outstanding balance within 10 days to avoid suspension.
Noah B: 50% partial is reasonable to protect cash. Also request their AP to reinstate autopay or provide wire.
CFO - Priya K: Approve provisional credit approach. No permanent write-off without final audit. We should also offer a 1% early-pay incentive if they pay the 50% within 5 days.
Sam R (Legal): Fine on 1% incentive. Ensure we capture acceptance in email and attach to account. If they fail to pay the 50%, we proceed with suspension and collections notice.
Noah B: Drafting message to billing@mirai-data.com: 
"We acknowledge your dispute re: April incident. We will complete an audit in 7 business days. To avoid service interruption, please remit 50% ($62,700) within 10 business days and confirm AP contact and payment method. Upon audit confirmation, we will issue a credit note for any verified charges. Early payment within 5 days receives 1% discount on the 50%. Failure to remit may result in suspension and referral to collections."
Tara L: Sending now and cc'ing CS and Legal. Also creating CS ticket link CS-10244 for the audit owner (Jamal).
BillingBot: Payment link sent. Automated follow-up scheduled in 7 days.
Collections Partner: FYI we received a hold request for MIRAI-501 pending audit. Will pause outreach until 1743070000. Please notify if plan changes.
Noah B: Got confirmation from AP that they'll wire 50% within 3 business days and emailed signed acceptance of the provisional terms.
BillingBot: Wire received: $62,700 (txn: WIRE-451002). Remaining balance: $62,700.
Tara L: Audit complete: confirmed 28% eligible credit on April usage. Credit amount: $35,112. Applying credit now and issuing credit note CN-2241.
Noah B: Applying credit reduces balance to $27,588. Update ledger and send adjustment invoice.
Sam R (Legal): Please attach signed acceptance and credit note to contract folder. Collections partner notified of outcome.
Noah B: Done. Marking invoice status -> "Resolved - Adjusted". If customer misses any future payments we'll follow escalation path. :white_check_mark:
